extraction_warnings: Source PDF tariff codes are in no-dot 8-digit format (NNNNNNNN). All tariff codes normalized to NNNN.NN.NN by inserting dots after positions 4 and 6.

Section XI Main Notes (Notes 1-15 plus Note 2 sub-clauses through Note 9) appear in the source PDF preamble but are intentionally omitted here — they are shared across Chapters 50-63 and have already been captured in Chapter 51/62 extracts per project convention.

Source PDF column header order for Chapter 55 notes table is 'SI.No. | Notes | Notification Date | Notification No' (Date before No), inverted from the typical 'Notification No | Date' order. Preserved column semantics as labelled.

Source PDF contains apparent OCR/typographic artifacts in Chapter Note 1: 'a length' rendered cleanly; preserved verbatim. Note that the Section XI Main Notes preamble (not extracted here) contains several OCR artifacts including: 'asif', 'consistingwholly', 'materilas' (materials), 'whcih' (which), 'occurs last' joining errors, 'isto' (is to), 'travelsetsforsewing', 'Restrcited' (Restricted), and stray quadruple-quote artifacts ("""") around terms such as 'twine, cordage, ropes and cables', 'put up for retail sale', 'made up', 'sewing thread', 'Z' (twist), and 'high tenacity yarn'.

Heading 5507 in source PDF lists the heading twice — once as the heading row 'Artificial staple fibres, carded, combed or otherwise processed for spinning.' and again as a pseudo-subheading '550700' with the same description. This pattern is preserved verbatim: heading 5507 has a single subheading 5507.00 with five tariff lines (5507.00.10 through 5507.00.90).

Sub-heading 5513.12 description in source PDF wraps across two table rows: '-- 3-thread or 4-thread twill, including cross twill, of polyester' continues with 'staple fibres' on the next row. Reassembled into a single subheading title verbatim.

Heading 5513 sub-headings 5513.21, 5513.23, 5513.29, 5513.31, 5513.39, 5513.41, 5513.49 in source PDF appear as flat 8-digit codes directly under their fibre/finish categories (Dyed, Of yarns of different colours, Printed) without intermediate 6-digit subheading rows. They are normalised here under their implicit 6-digit subheadings (5513.21, 5513.23, 5513.29, 5513.31, 5513.39, 5513.41, 5513.49) preserving the source PDF's verbatim 8-digit code descriptions on the tariff lines.

Heading 5514 sub-headings 5514.21, 5514.22, 5514.23, 5514.29, 5514.41, 5514.42, 5514.43, 5514.49 in source PDF appear as flat 8-digit codes directly (Dyed and Printed groups) without intermediate 6-digit subheading rows. They are normalised here under their implicit 6-digit subheadings preserving verbatim 8-digit descriptions.

Heading 5516 sub-headings 5516.12, 5516.13, 5516.22, 5516.23, 5516.32, 5516.33, 5516.34, 5516.42, 5516.43, 5516.44, 5516.92, 5516.93, 5516.94 in source PDF appear as flat 8-digit codes directly under their group descriptions without intermediate 6-digit subheading rows. They are normalised here under their implicit 6-digit subheadings preserving verbatim 8-digit descriptions.
Chapter 55 has exactly one Chapter Note, one Supplementary Note, and one Policy Condition in its dedicated notes section. No section_notes are captured here (Section XI scope, see warning above).
Chapter Note 1 references headings 5501-5504 — these are the filament tow and staple fibre headings to which the tow specifications apply.
Policy Condition 1 (Holy Quran imprint restriction) source text reads 'Restrcited' (likely 'Restricted'); preserved verbatim.
Sub-heading 5503.11 ('Of aramids:') uses a trailing colon in the source PDF rendering, indicating it is a parent group for tariff lines 5503.11.10/20/90. Preserved verbatim.
Sub-heading 5503.30 ('Acrylic or modacrylic:') and sub-heading 5503.90 ('Other') open further 8-digit splits in source PDF; preserved with verbatim descriptions.

Sub-heading 5504.10 ('Of viscose rayon') sub-splits into wood-other-than-bamboo (5504.10.11/19), bamboo (5504.10.21/29), and Other (5504.10.90). Sub-heading 5504.90 ('Other') sub-splits into 5504.90.10/20/30/90.

Notification No and Notification Date columns are blank for all Chapter 55 entries in the source PDF (Chapter Notes, Supplementary Notes, Policy Conditions, and all tariff lines). All tariff lines carry Export Policy 'Free' where explicitly populated; heading and sub-heading rows have no policy assigned in source.

Source PDF table indents (using -- and ---- markers) for sub-heading and tariff line descriptions are preserved verbatim where present in the source (e.g. ': --', ': ----'); where source contained none, none are added.

chapter_notes.text: Headings 5501 and 5502 apply only to man-made filament tow, consisting of parallel filaments of a uniform length equal to the length of the tow, meeting the following specifications : (a) length of tow exceeding 2 m; (b) twist less than 5 turns per metre; (c) measuring per filament less than 67 decitex; (d) synthetic filament tow only: the tow must be drawn, that is to say, be incapable of being stretched by more than 100% of its length; (e) total measurement of tow more than 20,000 decitex. Tow of a length not exceeding 2 m is to be classified in heading 5503 or 5504.

For the purposes of this Chapter, inherent Fire Retardant (FR) fibres, as specified in IS 11871, IS 13501, IS 15742, IS 15742 A, are those in which the FR properties are naturally part of the polymer backbone and can never be worn away or washed out.
